observation.command: echo "=== app.log tail ==="; tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log; echo "=== cms.log tail ==="; tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/cms.log; echo "=== boards.log tail ==="; tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/boards.log; echo "=== port states ==="; for p in 43189 41487 37315; do node -e 'const{createConnection}=require("net");const s=createConnection({port:parseInt(process.argv[1]),host:"127.0.0.1",timeout:800});const r=(m)=>{console.log(process.argv[1],m);s.destroy();process.exit(0)};s.on("connect",()=>r("OPEN"));s.on("error",(e)=>r(e.code));s.on("timeout",()=>r("timeout"))' $p; done; free -m | sed -n '1,2p'
